title: Improved bounds on the average length of longest common subsequences
key_contribution: Established the best known upper bound γ₂ ≤ 0.826280 using Markov chain methods and careful probabilistic analysis

title: Bounding the Expected Length of Longest Common Subsequences and Forests
key_contribution: Uses Markov chains and Kolmogorov complexity to derive upper and lower bounds on γ_σ for various alphabet sizes

title: A Central Limit Theorem for the Length of the Longest Common Subsequence in Random Words
key_contribution: Proves CLT for LCS length under certain conditions; provides variance bounds via entropy/martingale methods

title: Concentration inequalities and the entropy method (tutorial)
key_contribution: Tutorial on entropy method for concentration inequalities; covers Efron-Stein, logarithmic Sobolev, and transportation methods applicable to LCS
